thread:
harper: Short thread to lock down a compact GA acceptance checklist for the upcoming inference release. Need crisp owners so release engineers can gate the pipeline.

dan: Suggest we split acceptance into three checkpoints: reliability, observability, and commercial readiness. Each gets a binary pass/fail with an owner.

zoe: Observability checklist (I can own): per-route dashboards, synthetic latency & correctness probes, alert routing mapped to oncall. Requirement: synthetic probe run every 5m + historical 14d smoke metrics.

infra: Reliability (I can own): regional availability >= 99.8% over 7d rolling, 95p tail latency <= 400ms on typical prompt mix, automated fallback to smaller model within 30s on degraded nodes. Need a load schedule for burst test.

cfo-bot: Commercial: pricing validated against cost model (tokens->$), pilot invoicing flow, quota/soft-limit defaults set. Also need a simple billing backstop for early pilot overruns.

harper: Nice. Also add docs: public API spec, error codes, rate limits, and a one-pager on migration from pilot to GA. Devex can do the last-mile examples.

dan: Proposed gating rule: all three checkpoints must be Pass. If Observability or Reliability are Fail, release is blocked. Commercial Fail can permit limited pilot release with explicit exemptions.

zoe: I'll create the observability ticket and schedule a 48h alert burn-in. infra: can you draft a burst test script (k6 or locust) and an automated run for the release pipeline?

infra: Yep. I'll add `k6 run ga_burst.js --vus 100 --duration 10m` to the pipeline as a pre-merge gate. Also adding circuit-break thresholds: 5xx rate >1% for 1m -> throttle.

cfo-bot: billing-checker: cost-validation job queued (ID BC-202).

harper: Owners & ETAs: Observability -> zoe (ETA 3 days), Reliability -> infra (ETA 4 days), Commercial -> cfo-bot & finance (ETA 5 days), Docs -> devex (ETA 6 days). I'll add the pass/fail gates to the release board once tickets exist.

harper: Any objections? If none I'll formalize the checklist and tag in the release plan.

dan: no objections. Let's keep exceptions minimal.
